resources.name: ORCA quantum chemistry package

access.notes: Free for academic use. The agent must install it and use it for all DFT calculations.

resources.notes: Open-source quantum chemistry program. Version 5 or later recommended.

resources.name: Initial molecular geometries (XYZ)

access.notes: XYZ coordinate files for CuTAPP, CuTPP and the optimized gas-phase molecules H2 and H2O are provided in the task package; the structures of the adsorbed intermediates (*CO, *CHO) are built by the agent from these and reasonable starting distances.

resources.notes: The agent may also generate the structures from SMILES; the bundled files serve as a reference to avoid ambiguity.
